error_analysis.question: What was the ratio of salary-week average basket size to off-week average basket size in Kano during Q3 2025?
error_analysis.generated_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN d.is_salary_week = 1 THEN 'Salary Week (25th-30th)' ELSE 'Off-Week (1st-24th, 31st)' END AS period_type, COUNT(DISTINCT d.sale_date) AS days_count, ROUND(SUM(d.revenue_ngn), 2) AS revenue_ngn, ROUND(SUM(d.revenue_ngn) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d.sale_date), 0), 2) AS avg_daily_revenue_ngn, SUM(d.orders_count) AS orders_count, ROUND(SUM(d.revenue_ngn) / NULLIF(SUM(d.orders_count), 0), 2) AS avg_basket_ngn FROM daily_sales AS d WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m', d.sale_date) BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-09' GROUP BY d.is_salary_week ORDER BY d.is_salary_week DESC LIMIT 500
error_analysis.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_salary_week = 1 THEN d.revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_salary_week = 1 THEN d.orders_count ELSE 0 END), 0)) / NULLIF((SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_salary_week = 0 THEN d.revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_salary_week = 0 THEN d.orders_count ELSE 0 END), 0)), 0), 4) AS basket_ratio FROM daily_sales d JOIN stores s ON d.store_id = s.store_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m', d.sale_date) BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-09' AND s.city = 'Kano' LIMIT 500
error_analysis.reason: Result mismatch: expected 1 rows x 1 cols, got 2 x 6
error_analysis.analysis: Multi-hop ratio/covariance statistical expression not in base semantic templates.

question_results.question: Show revenue per staff member by store in 2025.
question_results.generated_sql: WITH store_sales AS (SELECT d.store_id, ROUND(SUM(d.revenue_ngn), 2) AS revenue_ngn FROM daily_sales AS d WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', d.sale_date) = '2025' GROUP BY d.store_id), store_staff AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(staff_id) AS staff_count FROM staff WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_name, s.city, ss.revenue_ngn, st.staff_count, ROUND(ss.revenue_ngn / NULLIF(st.staff_count, 0), 2) AS revenue_per_staff_ngn FROM store_sales AS ss JOIN stores AS s ON ss.store_id = s.store_id JOIN store_staff AS st ON ss.store_id = st.store_id ORDER BY revenue_per_staff_ngn DESC LIMIT 500

question_results.question: Show product catalog count and average unit price by category.
question_results.generated_sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(p.unit_price_ngn), 2) AS avg_unit_price_ngn, ROUND(AVG(p.unit_cost_ngn), 2) AS avg_unit_cost_ngn, ROUND(AVG(100.0 * (p.unit_price_ngn - p.unit_cost_ngn) / NULLIF(p.unit_price_ngn, 0)), 2) AS avg_markup_pct FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY avg_unit_price_ngn DESC LIMIT 500

question_results.question: What is the correlation coefficient between store floor area and staff tenure across cities?
question_results.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(st.tenure_months), 2) AS avg_tenure_months, COUNT(*) AS staff_count FROM staff AS st JOIN stores AS s ON st.store_id = s.store_id WHERE st.active = 1 LIMIT 500
question_results.expected_sql: SELECT s.city, AVG(s.floor_area_sqm) AS avg_sqm, AVG(st.tenure_months) AS avg_tenure, ROUND(AVG(s.floor_area_sqm * st.tenure_months) - AVG(s.floor_area_sqm) * AVG(st.tenure_months), 2) AS covar_proxy FROM stores s JOIN staff st ON s.store_id = st.store_id GROUP BY s.city LIMIT 500
